text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival. On that 
day, all sorts of events are held to 
interact with the fans!

King Halo, naturally, was to participate 
in the event to entertain her fans—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—King Halo, who is running in the 1500m 
Bun-Eating Race, please make your way to 
the track immediately. Repeating..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! A runner so grand that even the 
broadcast eagerly awaits her entry! That 
is none other than—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Let me finish speaking!! ...Just when 
I was feeling so good, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, though. Keeping all my fans 
waiting isn't really my style."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Just you wait and see King's 
elegant bread-eating race!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Today's star attraction, King 
Halo, has made her grand entrance!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, King-chan. I'm so glad we made 
it in time~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
? Oh? But Spe-chan was the one who was 
most worried...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, King was in this group too, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Burly Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That group over there, I actually 
know all those girls!

text_block_list.name: Spectator (Fan for 1 Year)
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I wonder who's gonna win! I'm so 
excited!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, well then everyone, shall we take 
our positions~?
(KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's started! The bread-eating race! 
Who will reach the bread first—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, here comes King Halo! She's pulling 
off a stunning runaway sprint! And she 
grabs the bread—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—She can't reach it!! King Halo jumps 
again and again, but she just can't get 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Aaaand right here--!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Blazing sprint, soaring high, total hunt!! 
El is number one, deeeess!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose either!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And suddenly it's a three-way battle for 
the lead! What will become of King Halo, 
who led up until now...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: I STILL DIDN'T GET IT--?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator (Fan for 1 Year)
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, that girl... she hasn't been able 
to grab any bread for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Burly Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yeah... Plus, they're covered in mud... 
Shouldn't we let them use their hands 
now?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kiiiiiiieeeeh! I don't need your pity! 
I'll snag this piece of bread in no time!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Heeeyah!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nggghhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: But, it still won't come off—————!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Shut uuup! One more time, just one more 
time!!

text_block_list.name: Burly Spectator
text_block_list.text: Th-That's some crazy determination.

text_block_list.name: Spectator (Fan for 1 Year)
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right... But since we've 
come this far, ...I kind of want them to 
do their best until the very end.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what is this!? Everyone's cheers are 
going to King...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The ones who fought for the top spot in 
that race were El and the others, you 
know?!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, now, now~. This is the Fan 
Appreciation Festival, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to receive such passionate cheers 
regardless of winning or losing..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...King-chan's attitude must simply have 
a natural charm that draws people to her."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...You really are amazing, King-chan.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator (Fan for 1 Year)
text_block_list.text: Kiiing, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Burly Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it next time! Hang in there! 
Go for it, King Halo!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, just when will she finally grasp it?! 
Next up is King Halo's 11th attempt!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not 'someday'! I'm taking it next 
time! Just watch me, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Behold the overwhelming soaring power of 
the King--!
(SKRRRT!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez~~~! Why is this happening~~~?!

Cheered on by the crowd, King Halo 
continued to face the bread again and 
again after that.
(Chomp...!)
(Wooooaaaaah------!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I did it! I reaaally did ittt!

As a result, King Halo ended up in dead 
last, but...

...At any rate, King Halo firmly 
captivated the hearts of her fans.
